props.name: isRootOnly
props.description: Set on Breadcrumb.RootInteractive. Whether this is the only visible root item (no other breadcrumb items after it). - `true`: Shows the root icon (user is at root level, no navigation deeper) - `false`: Shows 'organizations' icon (user has navigated deeper) Only applies when no custom icon/src/name is provided in avatar prop.

props.name: variant
props.description: Set on Breadcrumb.RootInteractive. Visual style of the leading icon/avatar. - `default`: rounded avatar holding the icon; root-only icon is 'account' - `plain` (opt-in): bare icon with no avatar circle; root-only icon is 'globe'; `src`/`name` render a square avatar

props.name: expandInline
props.description: Set on Breadcrumb.Ellipsis. Opt-in: instead of opening a dropdown, clicking the ellipsis expands the hidden items in place as regular breadcrumb links, replacing the ellipsis. The button is labelled "Show full path" automatically. Note: once expanded, `Ellipsis` renders a Fragment of links instead of the button, so a `ref` passed to it is `null` while expanded.

props.name: showTooltip
props.description: Set on Breadcrumb.Ellipsis. Opt-in: label the ellipsis button "Show full path" (`aria-label` + tooltip). Requires a `TooltipProvider` ancestor. Defaults to `false`, so existing dropdown ellipses are unchanged (no label, no tooltip). With `expandInline` the button is always labelled, and this only adds the tooltip.
